verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs your own Docker images as full hardware-isolated VMs close to users. It generates Dockerfiles for Node apps, so Node code is not confined to a restricted runtime subset. However, the delivery model is VMs/apps rather than edge/serverless functions, and the evidence never states that unmodified npm packages are supported. The reviewer's concern is valid: VM hosting supports partial credit, not complete coverage. Missing for 10: a documented function-style serverless execution model, explicit statement of unmodified Node.js/npm package compatibility, independent or hands-on corroboration of running Node workloads at the edge.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
